The villa

A whole house at the foot of the rocks

Villa Under Meteora is a detached two-storey house of 170 m² on the edge of Kalambaka, where the town ends and the rocks of Meteora begin. It is rented as a whole, so the living room, the kitchen, the garden and every balcony belong only to you and your company.

Inside: a large open living room with a fireplace and white sofas, a fully equipped kitchen with an island, four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Outside: a garden with a shaded lounge, a sun terrace, a dining table under the sky, and balconies on both sides — one towards the town and the plain, one towards the rocks.

  • Fireplace, air-conditioning and heating
  • Free Wi-Fi and free parking on the street
  • Self check-in with clear instructions
  • Children welcome · free cot on request

Fully equipped for cooking for ten: oven, hob, dishwasher, refrigerator, coffee machine, kettle and all the cookware you need — and a long island to gather around. The supermarket is a few minutes away by car.

Questions

How many guests does the villa sleep?

Up to ten. The villa has four bedrooms with seven beds — two rooms with a large double bed, one with a double and a single, one with a bunk bed and a single — plus a sofa bed in the living room. There are two bathrooms.

Where exactly is Villa Under Meteora?

On Christou Sakellaridi street in Kalambaka (422 00), on the slope right below the rocks of Meteora. It is 1 km from the Church of the Dormition and 1.2 km from the railway station.

How far are the Meteora monasteries?

The Meteora monastic complex is about 2 km away. The Monastery of Agios Nikolaos Anapafsas and the Monastery of Agios Stefanos are close by.

Do I need a car?

We recommend one. The villa sits on high ground at the foot of the rocks, and a car makes it easy to reach the town, the monasteries and the villages around. Parking on the street is free.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 15:00 to 00:30 and check-out is until 11:00. Please let us know your arrival time in advance; you can also check in by yourselves with the instructions we send you.

Is it warm in winter?

Yes. The villa has heating, air-conditioning and a fireplace in the living room — ideal for a winter escape to Meteora.

Is the villa suitable for families with children?

Yes, children of every age are welcome. There are baby safety gates and board games, and a cot for babies under one year old is free on request. Extra beds cannot be added.

Are pets, smoking or parties allowed?

No. Pets are not allowed, the whole house is non-smoking, and parties or events are not hosted.

Is there Wi-Fi and parking?

Yes. Wi-Fi is free throughout the house and parking on the street next to the villa is free as well.

How do I book?

Choose your dates and number of guests in the «Book your stay» form and press the button: the villa opens on Booking.com with your dates, where you see availability and price and book securely.
